Very disappointed. This is a shop I regularly go to for my cat. I had bought a litter box without the rim, and after paying at the checkout, I went back to the shop to get the rim I had forgotten. A woman, with a condescending air, told me that the rim wasn't sold separately, that I shouldn't have been sold the litter box alone, and that therefore she couldn't sell me the rim separately. I told her that if I had been sold a litter box by itself in this shop, they could logically sell me the rim, which she refused to do. I didn't think I'd have to complain about a simple litter box rim, but given the frosty exchange we had, I was really disappointed. We're talking about a litter box rim, after all...

I was very disappointed by the service. The young man was pretentious and unprofessional, offended by my annoyance at my initial denial of having an order in my name. He only told me much later, after he'd neglected to check my loyalty card, which I offered him, that my first and last names were reversed! So, of course, it could only be my fault! When I told him that someone else had entered my name, he still refused to acknowledge the truth! And naturally, I was the one being disrespectful because I raised my voice! He made no attempt to resolve the issue, which happens regularly at their establishment—but I've never been treated like such an idiot! It was my responsibility to fix the problem, not his. He was there to witness the customers' stupidity, no doubt. So, instead of making inappropriate remarks, sir, perhaps you should reconsider your methods. You're still young and have a lot to learn!
